description: Geoportal.lt, Lithuania's national spatial information portal, offers a municipal map viewer for each municipality, and the Kaunas city map is one example. The viewer read on 2026-09-28 shows the municipality boundary over map, orthophoto, hybrid or grey base maps at scales from 1:500 to 1:3,000,000, with tools to identify and compare layers, and a set of national layers: administrative boundaries and addresses, the real property cadastre map of parcels, abandoned land, protected areas and forest cadastres, the cultural heritage register, the electricity network data and gas network data of ESO (the national distribution system operator), land management planning documents and registered territories. Coverage is national, viewed municipality by municipality. Access is free in the browser; the geoportal's copyright terms apply and were not read, and no download is offered in the viewer. Caveats: network layers may be generalised for public display, and bulk access to ESO data would need the operator or geoportal services. It supports electricity and gas distribution network models and hazard exposure studies in Lithuanian cities. Related record: data-rrt-lithuania-broadcasting-station-permits covers Lithuanian telecom sites.
